needs.premise: Linearizable custody transitions with complete scan-ready root maps and live dispatch-origin premises; unknown remains retained; externally confirmed stop/drain actions are assumptions, not observed platform events.
Conditional publish/ack/collect Step preservation, overlap-before-ack, raw epoch exclusion, identity and reclamation premises; no full QNT/source/C simulation.

RootHandle namespace/generation lookup from live VM anchor, pin-retire ordering and opaque-only waiting; bare movable SCMOBJ must not be upgraded retroactively; classify immortal/owned-still separately.

Mapped parent source lease exists before foreign export; child acceptance covers roots before source release; park complete parent on close without keeping raw borrower active or violating synchronous C ABI.
Generated SFUN plus ___run marker entry; captured target origin before marker allocation and stable activation identity across nested selector effects; preserve marker and code lifetime.

Classify actual converter outputs and cleanup; reuse still/permanent retention where valid, cover initialization and inter-conversion GC, and all-context scanner/FFI writes without assuming every result moves.

Actual Tcl ClientData and function-pointer producers must establish pre-entry lifetime, stable activation selector and delete/queued-call/in-flight drain; inactive os_dyn thunk code is not Darwin arm64 capability.
Actual C pin/retire, source-to-child acceptance, close/park, scan/update/reload and reclaim edges; ordinary C object lifetime, setjmp automatic-local rules and lock adapters still require refinement.
Normal/conversion error and ___call/___run rethrow paths need canonical cleanup progress, nested duty, accepted result/error and data-write closure before freeing roots/marker/code.

Prove RootHandle or inherited parent-borrow origin before any wait/root copy; raw movable SCMOBJ ingress without prior root authority is rejected. Protect proc and incoming SCMOBJ before marker allocation, root each converted prefix; reserve only after collecting conversions and before outgoing stores; prove catcher/cleanup ownership.

Collector-updateable RootView scanner for every context, nested view lifetime, native borrow exclusion, old-reader pin and relocation reload; processor0 RC scanning does not close arbitrary-owner roots.

Concrete gate/allocator lock order, C object provenance, reads-from and release/acquire edges, complete writer coverage and descriptor reclamation; current target macros are not automatically qualified.
Prove logical root custody despite changed physical layout on denial, close/enter linearization, unknown debt reconciliation and same-call reentry without duplicate construction.

callers.actualChain: command create alloc_rc + make_vector + set_data_rc -> scheme_call_cmd data_rc -> tcltk_call SFUN -> apply; delete releases vector and RC
callers.hazard: ClientData must carry a stable acceptor/handle origin before data_rc. Pin callback dispatch before raw payload read; nested deletion must close new entry and defer reclaim until in-flight and queued-entry evidence drains.
callers.replacement: Vector is explicitly STILL with initial strong retention; do not classify it as an unrooted movable argument. Moving fields, delete lifetime and nonzero RC scan remain separate.

callers.actualChain: foo function argument hop -> SCMOBJ_to_FUNCTION c-define static host -> foo calls f -> hop converter
callers.hazard: Static c-define code identity does not need c_closure_self. Root native SCMOBJ arguments according to their origins; nested C string conversion has its own retained-object ownership.
callers.replacement: This retained source is not a new native execution witness; static entry must still validate VM owner/activation and closure/GC admission.

callers.actualChain: non-c-define procedure -> make_c_closure alloc_rc/data -> thunk writes c_closure_self -> converter -> marker reads closure payload
callers.hazard: Capture stable export/activation identity before allocating marker, preserve it across nested entry, and drain dispatch before reclaiming executable backing. TLS alone does not supply nested identity or lifetime.
callers.replacement: C_CLOSURE_CODE_SIZE in this source covers selected x86-32/ppc32/sparc branches, not a demonstrated Darwin arm64 dynamic thunk. Unsupported targets reject; explicit userdata adapters can avoid this route.

callers.actualChain: BEGIN_SFUN marker before conversion; SCMOBJ-prioritized conversions; SFUN_ARG then call; generated END conversion releases
callers.hazard: Emit an ingress descriptor before marker; classify incoming RootHandle/parent borrow/owned-still/immortal/scalar. Publish child view and conversion prefix before dropping source roots.
callers.replacement: A raw SCMOBJ is a representation, not origin evidence. Existing owned-still results may reuse retention rather than adding duplicate root slots.

callers.actualChain: ___run sets R0 -> BEGIN_TRY -> make marker(thunk) -> call -> kill marker -> END_TRY
callers.hazard: ___run is another real marker producer outside SFUN. Require a rooted thunk origin and canonical activation cleanup so nonlocal error cannot silently skip kill/custody close.
callers.replacement: No claim that adding guards only to generated SFUN covers bootstrap, processor run, or raw direct ___call users.

allocators.sourceAnchors: VM RootRegistry is proposed; current rc primitives at lib/mem.c:705-831
allocators.actualPath: registered opaque identity -> namespace/generation lookup -> storage pin -> gate admission -> payload read
allocators.contract: Lookup from a live VM anchor; pin/retire serialize. Handle pin protects storage while registered root cell remains scan/update-owned. It does not prohibit GC.
allocators.failure: If closed, wait using identity only and reload after round seal; never preserve a raw movable copy across collection.
allocators.custodian: Registry retains handle cell until pin/readers/terminal drain. Generation wrap must reject reuse or prove a stronger bound.

allocators.actualPath: parent frame/root view -> source lease -> child view publish -> acknowledgement
allocators.contract: Child publication accepts roots before raw borrow ends; acknowledgement releases parent source duty. Lost ACK queries the same activation/request, never registers twice.
allocators.failure: If GC closes before publication, park the complete parent view and stop raw accesses; retaining an active borrow while waiting for OPEN creates a wait cycle.
allocators.custodian: Parent retains custody until child acceptance; canonical child retains it after acceptance even if response is lost.

allocators.actualPath: C conversion creates still refcount1 or permanent object; still setup scans positive refcount; release_scmobj drops still count
allocators.contract: Reuse known still/permanent ownership with typed cleanup. Initialization must finish before another allocation; stable address does not mean fields can be mutated during scan.
allocators.failure: Conversion failure retains or releases the exact initialized prefix once; transfer between existing refcount and managed view needs an explicit receipt.
allocators.custodian: Original converter owns until child/foreign result acceptor acknowledges; no blanket replacement of every still root by another handle.

allocators.actualPath: callback -> child SFUN -> Scheme -> native/event reentry -> another callback
allocators.contract: Stable parent/child activation keys and activation-local selector; freeze/reload all participating views, marker and conversion prefixes. Do not key solely by OS thread or processor number.
allocators.failure: Child return restores exact parent binding/control state; parent cannot detach while nested responsibility remains, including unknown exit.
allocators.custodian: Each view owns its marker, initialized conversions and result/error until the designated acceptor takes custody.

allocators.actualPath: normal END cleanup versus ___call rethrow/nonlocal longjmp and propagate_error
allocators.contract: Use VM-canonical cleanup progress and terminal receipt; interception must precede escaping to an older catcher. Do not rely only on lexical epilogue or changed nonvolatile automatic locals after longjmp.
allocators.failure: Unknown exit keeps roots and native backing; confirmed stop closes writes but does not by itself settle nested tasks/result delivery or library queues.
allocators.custodian: Reclaim after accepted result/error, no nested roots/readers/pins, no unknown write, and actual dispatch drain.

orders.orderContract: VM lookup and handle pin/retire share a coherent gate; only read opaque token until accepted.
orders.rejectedShortcut: A pointer to already-freed handle/code/clientData cannot be made safe by addref after entry. External unregister/queued-call drain evidence is required.

orders.orderContract: Parent source lease covers every read before child root registration. Child acceptance and raw-borrow relinquish are one custody transition; acknowledgement can be later.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Do not decrement parent coverage then link child roots. Lost ACK retains overlapping custody and uses canonical query.

orders.orderContract: Close stops new raw-entry claims before waiting. Already pinned handle storage may persist while its payload cell is scanned; parent raw borrow must park/transfer or abort from a full view.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Do not wait for gate reopening while the same active borrow prevents collector entry. Opaque pins and raw execution authority are distinct.

orders.orderContract: Child root acceptance precedes marker allocation; each conversion publishes a safe initialized prefix before the next collecting allocation.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Existing still-owned results are already retained in their qualified profile; stable-address ownership does not prove arbitrary field writes or nonzero RC coverage.

orders.orderContract: Activation-local selector is captured before allocating/reentering and restored from the parent activation, not reread from mutable global state.
orders.rejectedShortcut: TLS removes cross-thread sharing only; nested overwrite/cleanup still needs stack discipline and executable-entry lifetime. No arm64 support is inferred from inactive thunk code.

orders.orderContract: Canonical root/marker/resource cleanup receipt precedes terminal propagation; accepted result/error backing remains pinned until receiver acknowledgement.
orders.rejectedShortcut: A kill call textually after ___call is not guaranteed to run when ___call rethrows. C setjmp cleanup state needs defined lifetime and value rules.

orders.orderContract: Collector-exclusive slot updates happen-before acquired resume/reload; reclamation additionally drains all descriptor/code/clientData readers and native dispatch.
orders.rejectedShortcut: Release/acquire visibility is not storage lifetime. Unknown results cannot count as cancelled, reclaimed, or harmless solely by timeout.

costs.removedWork: Avoid stale raw payload copies across closed epochs
costs.bound: Opaque identity only while waiting; payload load after admission
costs.condition: Benefit is correct decoupled admission; CPU improvement is not established.

costs.removedWork: Avoid copying every live parent value into a new handle
costs.bound: Reuse mapped locations when compiler certificate covers them
costs.addedCost: Borrow/accept/ack bookkeeping; possible duplicate root coverage until ACK
costs.condition: Positive work reduction requires fewer copies than registration/coordination work.

costs.bound: Known still refcount1; no forced duplicate per-result handle
costs.addedCost: Typed ownership classification and once-only cleanup receipt
costs.condition: A smaller measured profile may need no extra root payload for these results; source/scan closure remains required.

costs.removedWork: Explicit root words for input and converted prefix
costs.bound: Illustrative 4 inputs + 2 converted at 8 bytes: 48B; depth2: 96B
costs.condition: These are native-evaluated model payload examples, not measured allocation or mandatory net added memory.

costs.removedWork: Retire implicit nested generated release assumptions for admitted path
costs.bound: O(initialized-prefix) cleanup, exactly one accepted custodian
costs.addedCost: Progress tracking, result/error receipt, longjmp-safe state
costs.condition: No global GC blocker may be hidden in unknown cleanup effects.

costs.bound: O(depth * live root slots) plus native activation backing
costs.addedCost: Activation stack, marker/result retention and root reload
costs.condition: Depth/borrow duration bounds are needed for bounded peak; no such general bound is proved.

costs.removedWork: Avoid needing a machine-code closure when API supplies context
costs.bound: Use ClientData as a managed acceptor identity
costs.addedCost: Adapter changes and delete/in-flight/queued-call drain contract
costs.condition: Does not establish generic C ABI callback closure support or raw ClientData safety after deletion.

costs.removedWork: Retire global selector dependency only after certified replacement
costs.bound: 0 dynamic-thunk support newly established on Darwin arm64
costs.addedCost: Target ABI/backend or mature closure library, executable lifetime, nested selector protocol
costs.condition: Modern C alone cannot synthesize arbitrary context-free callback closures portably.

costs.removedWork: Avoid premature reclamation and lost roots
costs.bound: Peak=max_t(unique backing + separate roots/maps + native/dispatch escrow)
costs.addedCost: Overlapping parent/child roots and unknown native resources may remain retained
costs.condition: No bounded peak reduction or GC latency claim without stop/drain and origin evidence.

costs.removedWork: Isolate forthcoming C-layer refactor decisions from language expansion
costs.bound: vendor branch modern-c at recorded unchanged source commit
costs.addedCost: Future implementation and native qualification are separate tasks
costs.condition: This turn creates the branch only; existing vector edit preserved; no production path retired.
